question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Earn
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is 'Earn' which refers to obtaining money in return for work or services provided (Hindi meaning: कमाना). 
 
• For example: He earns by working overtime.
 
• The correct synonym is 'Receive' which can imply obtaining something as a result of one's behavior or activities (Hindi meaning: प्राप्त करना). 
 
• For example: He received a good income from his investment.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 1'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Lose' (Hindi meaning: खोना) denotes be deprived of or cease to have or retain.
 
• 'Accord' (Hindi meaning: सहमत होना) typically means to grant someone a right or a status.
 
• 'Surrender' (Hindi meaning: समर्पित करना) means to give up or hand over.
